The function should instead calculate the maximum servings of each dish independently based on the available ingredients and then sum these values.

3. Calculate the remaining ingredients after making the maximum servings of dish A.
4. Calculate the maximum number of servings of dish B that can be made with the remaining ingredients.
5. Sum the maximum servings of dishes A and B to get the total maximum servings.
